name: Tensor-Train Decomposition for 4D Volumes
definition: A tensor decomposition method for 4D time-dependent volume data optimized for low time and memory usage, allowing processing of notably larger datasets than TTHRESH, tntorch, and default SSVD.
summary: TT4D is a memory-efficient lossy compression technique for 4D volumes that enables random-access decoding of individual time steps without reconstructing the entire tensor, distinguishing itself through fixed-rate compression and linear tensor cores.
